name: magpie-search-mix
description: A magpie web search API that asks two or more search APIs at once and merges their pages.
author: mdwsk88

summary.en: A web search API that asks two or more search APIs at once (Tavily, Brave, Exa, You.com, DeepSeek, SearXNG and more) and merges their pages, deduplicated.
summary.zh: 联网搜索 API：同时问两家或更多搜索 API（Tavily、Brave、Exa、You.com、DeepSeek、SearXNG 等），去重后合并结果。
